        elif best_swerc[0] == best_full[0]:
            if best_swerc[1] <= best_full[1]:
                print("Infinity")
                return
        
        # Binary search
        low = 1
        high = 10**15
        ans = 0
        
        while low <= high:
            mid = (low + high) // 2
            cost_swerc = get_min_cost(swerc_banks, mid)
            cost_all = get_min_cost(set(range(1, N+1)), mid)
            
            if cost_swerc <= cost_all:
                ans = mid
                low = mid + 1
            else:
                high = mid - 1
        
        print(ans)
